notes.title: Flight System Rework and Patch Notes
notes.content: [h1]Improved Flight Model[/h1][p]In Version 0.3.8 A new and Improved Flight model has been added, with this model the flight physics will be more realistic. Some control surfaces of the aircraft are also animated ,this includes the Ailerons, Flaps, Rudder and Elevator. The Gear and props will be animated in the next update. The Improved flight model can be accessed from the main menu and in later updates will be fully implemented into the main game. Along with the flight model a new Aircraft Hangar is available, however currently it doesn't serve much of a purpose.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663134/2819d65398c23a25e4fd7150d4d3f990c31dbacc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Map preview - Klaipeda[/h2][p]This update also includes a preview of the main map the base game will include. The map is based off the Klaipeda coastline and Curonian spit, currently the terrain resolution is fairly low also you will notice the there are no textures other than the heightmap visualisation.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663134/74ca30052aa85efe7b730c0b6b6c41ab30bf603f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]New Player Property - House[/h2][p]The new player house is based off of the common wooden eastern European houses found in most parts of Lithuania. The house will be furnished later, and there will also be a low level detail version available for NPC housing/decoration.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663134/a8b99b3260f07ff03ade1e98d4aab3fbab455dc0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Patch Notes:[/p][p]Version 0.3.8[/p][p]02/09/25 - Improved Flight Model, New Klaipeda map, Reworked Crouch System, [/p][p]                   Equipped objects can no longer be thrown, New player properties[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Plane and QoL updates
notes.content: [p]In Version 0.3.7 the game has received updates to quality of life, this involves a quality selector which can be accessed in the main menu and options menu when in game, currently the player can choose from a selection of graphical presets.[/p][p]The second part of this update involves the addition of the improved plane model, the plane now has a detailed exterior with multiple flight surfaces. In the future these surfaces and props will be animated.[/p][p][/p][h3]Improved Plane Model :[/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663134/010b66cec496573fd0d60c5069f73d5df72ebbb7.png"][/img][/h3][h3]ChangeLog[/h3][p]Since this is the first changelog update posted to the steam page I will also include previous changes below from v0.3.6 to v0.3.2:[/p][p]Date(DD/MM/YY) , Changes[/p][p]17/06/25  -logging job, mesh deformation/crash physics, signs added, roads added, lighting and fog[/p][p]12/06/25  -save load system added(WIP) , treewalls added, fixed settings[/p][p]11/06/25  -fixed vehicle physics, buildings updated, added terrain textures[/p][p]07/06/25  -Convenience store building added, fixed player movement[/p][p]04/06/25  -Early Preview Released on steam[/p]

notes.title: Store Page Launched
notes.content: [p]Today on the 17th of June the store page has been launched [/p][previewyoutube="GEr-K-Fhhhg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The game is on track to release in 2026(early access), expect many updates until then as well as a demo[/p][p]which may or may not act as a prequel.[/p]
